# Master Analysis Runner

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(knitr)
library(here)

# Execution log accumulator
analysis_results <- data.frame(
  File = character(),
  Status = character(),
  Duration = character(),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
options(warn = -1)

# Extracts R code from a QMD file via knitr::purl(), executes it with
# suppressed console output, and records pass/fail status with elapsed time.
run_qmd <- function(qmd_path, i, n) {
  start_time <- Sys.time()
  
  cat(sprintf("  [%d/%d] %-60s ... ", i, n, basename(qmd_path)))
  utils::flush.console()
  
  # Extract R code from QMD
  temp_r <- tempfile(fileext = ".R")
  purl_res <- try(knitr::purl(here(qmd_path), output = temp_r, quiet = TRUE, documentation = 0), silent = TRUE)
  
  if (inherits(purl_res, "try-error")) {
    cat("PURL ERROR\n")
    analysis_results <<- rbind(analysis_results, data.frame(
      File = qmd_path, Status = "PURL ERROR", Duration = "0s"
    ))
    return(invisible(FALSE))
  }
  
  # Execute with suppressed output
  success <- TRUE
  err_msg <- ""
  
  null_dev <- if (.Platform$OS.type == "windows") "NUL" else "/dev/null"
  msg_con <- file(null_dev, open = "wt")
  
  on.exit({
    try({
      sink(type = "message")
      if (isOpen(msg_con)) close(msg_con)
      sink()
    }, silent = TRUE)
  }, add = TRUE)
  
  res <- try({
    sink(null_dev)
    sink(msg_con, type = "message")
    source(temp_r, local = FALSE)
  }, silent = TRUE)
  
  # Restore sinks immediately to allow progress reporting
  try({
    sink(type = "message")
    if (isOpen(msg_con)) close(msg_con)
    sink()
  }, silent = TRUE)
  on.exit(NULL)
  
  if (inherits(res, "try-error")) {
    success <- FALSE
    err_msg <- attr(res, "condition")$message
  }
  
  if (file.exists(temp_r)) unlink(temp_r)
  
  end_time <- Sys.time()
  duration <- round(as.numeric(difftime(end_time, start_time, units = "secs")), 1)
  
  if (success) {
    status <- "PASS"
    cat(sprintf("PASS (%s s)\n", duration))
  } else {
    status <- "FAIL"
    cat("FAIL\n")
    cat(paste0("         ! ERROR: ", trimws(err_msg), "\n"))
  }
  
  analysis_results <<- rbind(analysis_results, data.frame(
    File = qmd_path,
    Status = status,
    Duration = paste0(duration, "s")
  ))
}

# Executes a named batch of QMD files and prints a section summary.
run_section <- function(section_name, files) {
  cat(paste0("\n=== ", toupper(section_name), " ===\n"))
  n <- length(files)
  for (i in seq_along(files)) {
    run_qmd(files[i], i, n)
  }
  
  cat("\nSection Summary:\n")
  section_res <- tail(analysis_results, n)
  print(section_res, row.names = FALSE)
  cat(rep("-", 80), "\n", sep = "")
  
  invisible(NULL)
}
```

## 2. Main Analysis (Manuscript Figures & Tables)
```{r, results='asis'}
#| eval: true
main_analysis_files <- c(
  "Code/1_Data_loading_baseline/02_Baseline_geography.qmd",
  "Code/4_Vulnerability_index_impact/04.1_Index_equal_weight.qmd",
  "Code/2_delta_travel_time/02.1_Baseline_Accessibility_Main.qmd",
  "Code/3_Pop_impact/03.1_Pop_Impact_Main.qmd",
  "Code/4_Vulnerability_index_impact/04.2_Vulnerability_Impact_Main.qmd"
)

run_section("Main Manuscript Analysis", main_analysis_files)
```
